nina (sec-eng): Heads up — several tenants in APAC report incomplete RBAC changes after the midnight key rotation. SCIM PATCHes return 204 but role.apply shows failures and audit shows gaps.

peter (infra): which region/hosts? any error snippets we can see?

nina (sec-eng): ap-southeast-1. Log excerpt from provisioner on ap-southeast-1d:

```
2026-04-05T00:03:12Z provisioner[pid=887]: ERROR apply-role tenant=delta-corp user=eva@delta err="KMS:encrypt failed: alias not found (alias/rdw/provisioner/2026-04-04)" corr=tx-c3de
2026-04-05T00:03:12Z provisioner[pid=887]: WARN queued deprov id=3b7a retry=backoff
2026-04-05T00:03:15Z provisioner[pid=887]: INFO scim/patch -> 204
```

olivia (sre): that pattern usually indicates agents bootstrapped with alias updated but missing the corresponding key id env. Can you check agent files?

peter (infra): running remote checks now. Commands to run on affected hosts:
```
sudo cat /etc/rdw/kms_alias || echo missing
sudo cat /etc/rdw/kms_key_id || echo missing
sudo journalctl -u rdw-bootstrap --since "2026-04-04 22:00" | tail -n 200
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:9250/health | jq .agent_kms_status
```

nina (sec-eng): checked ap-southeast-1d: kms_alias present alias/rdw/provisioner/2026-04-04 but kms_key_id file empty. Bootstrap logs show secret fetch failing: `secret not found` from vault.

vault-bot: Vault replication: ap-southeast-1 shard lagging. last_sync=2026-04-04T23:58:10Z pending_replicas=2/4.

olivia (sre): audit ingestion metrics also show drops around that time. securitybot?

securitybot: Alert: audit.role_ops.ingest_drop fired 2026-04-05T00:05:00Z. drop_count=56 in 10m window. Severity=info.

peter (infra): confirmed root cause: vault replication lag + bootstrap treated missing secret as non-blocking so agent continued with partial config. That leaves agent able to send SCIM success but unable to perform crypto ops -> retries -> audit gaps.

nina (sec-eng): immediate remediation plan: 1) emergency inject kms_key_id from primary into affected hosts 2) restart rdw-bootstrap to re-run secret injection checks 3) restart provisioner to drain queues and replay deprov actions 4) collect evidence bundle for compliance (provisioner logs, bootstrap logs, /etc/rdw/* files, audit query).

olivia (sre): commands we ran during remediation:
```
sudo cp /opt/ops-snapshots/rdw_kms_key_id.ap-south-2026-04-04 /etc/rdw/kms_key_id
sudo systemctl restart rdw-bootstrap && sleep 5 && sudo systemctl restart provisioner
# check deprov queue length
curl -sS "http://localhost:9250/metrics" | grep deprov_queue
```

peter (infra): applied emergency inject on ap-southeast-1c and 1d, restarted services. Saw KMS:encrypt and KMS:sign lines come back within ~30s and queued actions began succeeding.

nina (sec-eng): collecting evidence now. Please include a grep for correlation ids (corr=tx-*) and the audit query used to detect missing role events. Upload sanitized bundle to /shared/sec-incidents/1849998888/.

olivia (sre): monitoring: audit ingest rate recovered to baseline within 90s. RBAC reconciler saw deltas converge. We should also confirm no tenants lost changes — run a compare of desired vs actual roles for affected tenants.

peter (infra): postmortem notes / proposed mitigations: - block alias rotation completion until vault replication > 3/4 replicas and secret present on all shards - make bootstrap fail-fast (exit non-zero) if REDWOOD_KMS_KEY_ID missing - add agent metric agent.kms_key_id_present (0/1) and alert when 0 - add audit.ingest_miss_rate alert for >10/min for role events - add runbook: emergency-inject-secret and safe-restart-provisioner.

nina (sec-eng): I'll own audit backfill using correlation ids and will notify Account Execs for impacted tenants. Peter, please open the runbook PR and a rollout pre-check change. Olivia, can you add the monitoring alerts?

peter (infra): opening PR now and tagging @peter (infra) for runbook, @nina (sec-eng) for audit backfill, @olivia (sre) for monitoring.

securitybot: Incident recorded INC-20260405-1402 severity=medium status=mitigated

olivia (sre): good catch team. Re-open if any regression. :thumbsup:
